title: How Casinos Always Win (The Math They Don't Show You)
alts: Why the House Always Wins: Casino Math Explained
Las Vegas Makes $1 Million an Hour. Here's How.
line1: How do casinos always win? Las Vegas Strip casinos kept $8.8 billion in 2025, about $1 million an hour. Here's the math and the tricks.
summary: Dave lands in Vegas with $500 and a plan: win. We explain the house edge on roulette (5.26%), blackjack and slots, how the law of large numbers turns a tiny edge into billions, the building's psychology tricks (no clocks, chips, free drinks, near misses, comps), and why sports betting apps grew 23% in a year.
